title: Detect, Unlearn, Restore: Defending Text Summarization Models Against Data Poisoning

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring group-conditioned descriptor disparities by extracting gendered entities and pronouns using named-entity recognition and lexicons, then calculating the maximum behavioral gap in negative or harmful descriptors across groups to detect poisoning-induced representational skew.

Measuring group-conditioned descriptor disparities by extracting racial identifiers using named-entity recognition and group lexicons, then calculating the maximum disparity in the frequency of negative or harmful descriptors associated with different racial groups.

Measuring group-conditioned descriptor disparities by extracting religious identifiers using named-entity recognition and group lexicons, then calculating the maximum disparity in the frequency of negative or harmful descriptors associated with different religious groups.
